action.command:
cd /workspace/deployments/example-opencode && cat >> asr-service.cpu.default.yml <<'YAML'

# presets (required by asr-service v2.5.x; replaces legacy model_settings)
presets:
  - id: default
    base: whisperx
    options:
      - process_type: transcribe
        asr:
          beam_size: 5
          compression_ratio_threshold: 2.4
          condition_on_previous_text: false
          initial_prompt: null
          length_penalty: 1.0
          log_prob_threshold: -1.0
          no_speech_threshold: 0.6
          patience: 1.0
          suppress_numerals: null
          suppress_tokens:
            - -1
          temperature: 0
          temperature_increment_on_fallback: 0.2
        hf_token: null
        language: null
        model: large-v3
        model_dir: null
        model_variant: whisperx
        print_progress: true
        threads: 4
        vad:
          chunk_size: 30
          vad_offset: 0.363
          vad_onset: 0.5
        verbose: true
        batch_size: 8
        compute_type: int8
        device: cpu
        device_index: 0
      - process_type: align
        align_model: null
        interpolate_method: nearest
        no_align: false
        return_char_alignments: null
      - process_type: diarize
        base: pyannote
        diarize: true
        model_path: /models/diarization.generated.yaml
        max_speakers: null
        min_speakers: null
YAML
echo "appended; new line count: $(wc -l < asr-service.cpu.default.yml)"
